{{Quote|If you make us do this, there won't be another harvest season.|Dilanni|<ref name="Bounty Hunters (episode)">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Dilanni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] who served as a member of the [[Farmer/Legends|farming]] community run by [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was training the farmers to defend themselves against [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]], Dilanni was pessimistic about their chances and believed that there would never be no chance to face these pirates. The farmer later saved [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] from a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]-riding [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] by throwing his spear at the pirate.<ref name="Bounty Hunters (episode)" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Stephen Stanton]], who also voices [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and various others in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|series]], lent his voice to Dilanni.<ref name="Bounty Hunters (episode)" />
